title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 100 ]

blocks.text: In an experiment on their behavior, baby monkeys were separated from their mothers at birth and provided with artificial mother. Some of their artificial mothers were made of cold, hard wire while others were made of warm, soft towel cloth. When given a choice between the two types of mothers, the monkeys repeatedly chose to spend their time with the towel cloth mothers. This experiment suggest that the baby monkeys looked for the comfort supplied by their contact with towel cloth mothers.

readingSentences.english: In an experiment on their behavior, baby monkeys were separated from their mothers at birth and provided with artificial mother.
readingSentences.korean: 그들의 행동에 대한 한 실험에서, 새끼 원숭이들은 태어나자마자 그들의 엄마 원숭이로부터 분리되어서 가짜 엄마에게 맡겨졌다.

readingSentences.english: Some of their artificial mothers were made of cold, hard wire while others were made of warm, soft towel cloth.
readingSentences.korean: 일부의 가짜 엄마들은 차갑고 단단한 철사로 만들어져 있었고 반면에 다른 가짜 엄마들은 따뜻하고 부드러운 수건 천으로 만들어져 있었다.

readingSentences.english: When given a choice between the two types of mothers, the monkeys repeatedly chose to spend their time with the towel cloth mothers.
readingSentences.korean: 그 두 유형의 엄마들 중에서 선택해야 했을 때, 새끼 원숭이들은 반복적으로 수건 천 엄마와 시간을 보내는 쪽을 선택했다.

readingSentences.english: This experiment suggest that the baby monkeys looked for the comfort supplied by their contact with towel cloth mothers.
readingSentences.korean: 이 실험은 새끼 원숭이들이 그들의 수건 천 엄마와의 접촉에 의해 제공되는 안락함을 찾는다는 것을 보여 준다.
